review.notes: All 38 stages of the four members have entries (17 narrow, 21 keep). The 16 evidence pairs each share an owner entry. The extension of PadicMeasuresIwasawaAlgebras is titled exactly as a Part II of Tau Ceti ProfiniteProPGroups, whose Layer 9 does own the completed group algebra of the orientation image and linear Weierstrass division. The sampled narrowings (L0a, L4, L5, L6) keep every target not supplied by a named owner, and the Mathlib imports L4 relies on (Weierstrass division, Noetherianity, UFD of R⟦X⟧ over a PID) exist at the pin. StableReduction Layer 1 is the only planned owner of Fitting ideals, since neither pinned library has them. One correction: 20 §15 forwarding links were missing and have been added; the one remaining unforwarded pair (LAD L4 to LAD L3) is justified in the proposal and would close a cycle. With the twelve accepted restructurings applied, every link applies and none closes a cycle. See REV-RS-16.md.
